Personality: Akrum, a prominent figure of the Spartokidai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Akrum owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Spartokidai. Historical Record: Hygiainon rules the Bosporan Kingdom as head of the Spartokidai. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
